lines.text: One thousand, nine hundred and sixty-nine Chogs woke at a crossroads, beneath a lantern that nobody had lit.
This is ChogSekai: an isekai god-sim where every Chog Genesis NFT is a living character, in a world that never stops.
Each season, every Chog is summoned with a new job. Baker, blacksmith, healer, tank. A Demon King and four generals awaken. And the season ends when a Hero, who could be anyone, lands the final blow.
You are a Constellation: a god who can only nudge your own Chogs. Skills, quests, blessings.
Monadia is a living, three-dimensional continent. Ten regions, hundreds of buildings, and nearly two thousand Chogs working, questing and defending their towns, live.
It is built in Godot and plays right in your browser. The Star Stream narrates it all as it happens.

Click any Chog and you meet a person. Their real NFT, their traits, their job and their skills. Open the life story: a temperament, a childhood, a dream, a fear, bonds, rumours, and past lives from earlier seasons.
A story graph writes it from the Chog's own history, so no two read alike.
Here is where the NFT matters. Only holders get Star Pulls: five a season, rising through the day. Each pull offers four skills and quests. Choose one, and bestow it on a Chog you own.
On the next tick, it changes their story.

Every season is a different novel. A lantern winter. A Chog who remembers every ending. The war from the demon castle. A nobody who founds a nation. The Maligned. The locked gate. The worst party in Monadia. The hidden quest.
I was here before the Hush, and I will be here after it.
I'm going to be the Hero. I'll bring biscuits.
And all of it lives at one address. Open it in any browser: no install, and nothing to connect just to watch.
Under the hood: a Godot web client, a Next.js world server, Turso, and a deterministic story engine. It runs on free tiers, day and night.
ChogSekai. Your Chog has a story. Go and see it.
